subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the broad fallback-policy tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 owns the guardrail subset, or reopen/narrow the split fallback issue and close this umbrella?
rationale: The current open/closed split is inconsistent, and both fallback ordering policy and model-input strictness require maintainer product/API intent before an implementation PR is safe.

options.title: Keep this broad tracker
options.body: Use this issue for benchmark-backed fallback ordering and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 as the focused guardrail contract tracker.

options.title: Reopen the fallback split
options.body: Reopen or recreate the fallback-only tracker, link it with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287, and then close this umbrella as superseded.

options.title: Defer benchmark policy
options.body: Resolve only the guardrail contract first and leave fallback benchmark/order work for a later maintainer-owned planning item.

recommendation.title: Keep this broad tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for benchmark-backed fallback ordering and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 as the focused guardrail contract tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent history across the fallback docs, media/provider catalog paths, and issue timeline, making him the best available routing owner for the product/API choice.
